description: Implementation of a distributed file-based key-value store for PyTorch, including file locking, file I/O, and synchronization mechanisms.

classes.name: Lock
classes.description: RAII wrapper for flock(2) file locking operations.

classes.name: File
classes.description: Encapsulates file operations including locking, reading, writing, and seeking.

classes.name: FileStore
classes.description: Distributed key-value store implementation using files for synchronization.

methods.name: syscall
methods.description: Utility to retry system calls interrupted by signals.

methods.name: Lock::Lock
methods.description: Constructor that acquires a lock on a file descriptor.

methods.name: Lock::~Lock
methods.description: Destructor that releases the lock.

methods.name: Lock::unlock
methods.description: Releases the lock on the file descriptor.

methods.name: File::File
methods.description: Constructor that opens a file with retries and timeout.

methods.name: File::lockShared
methods.description: Acquires a shared lock on the file.

methods.name: File::lockExclusive
methods.description: Acquires an exclusive lock on the file.

methods.name: File::seek
methods.description: Seeks to a position in the file.

methods.name: File::tell
methods.description: Returns current position in the file.

methods.name: File::size
methods.description: Returns the size of the file.

methods.name: File::write
methods.description: Writes data to the file.

methods.name: File::read
methods.description: Reads data from the file.

methods.name: File::write (string)
methods.description: Writes a string to the file with length prefix.

methods.name: File::write (vector)
methods.description: Writes a byte vector to the file with length prefix.

methods.name: File::read (string)
methods.description: Reads a length-prefixed string from the file.

methods.name: File::read (vector)
methods.description: Reads a length-prefixed byte vector from the file.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes cache from file, handling deletions.

methods.name: FileStore::clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the FileStore.

methods.name: FileStore::~FileStore
methods.description: Destructor that handles cleanup and file removal.

methods.name: FileStore::set
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in the store.

methods.name: FileStore::compareSet
methods.description: Compare-and-set operation for a key.

methods.name: FileStore::get
methods.description: Retrieves value for a key.

methods.name: FileStore::addHelper
methods.description: Helper to atomically add a value to a key.

methods.name: FileStore::add
methods.description: Adds a value to a key.

methods.name: FileStore::getNumKeys
methods.description: Returns number of keys.

methods.name: FileStore::deleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a key.

methods.name: FileStore::check
methods.description: Checks existence of multiple keys.

methods.name: FileStore::wait
methods.description: Waits until keys are available or timeout.

methods.name: FileStore::listKeys
methods.description: Lists all keys.
